# Padel Pilot Support

Padel Pilot supports Garmin Forerunner 265; D2 Mach 1; epix (Gen 2) and
quatix 7 Sapphire; epix Pro (Gen 2) 47 mm and quatix 7 Pro; fēnix 8 AMOLED
43 mm; fēnix E; Instinct 3 AMOLED 50 mm; Enduro; fēnix 7X, tactix 7,
quatix 7X Solar and Enduro 2; Enduro 3.

For help, bug reports or feature requests:

- Email: barna.viktor97@gmail.com

The current stable package is version **1.3.0**, for the devices above.
See [release notes](../docs/releases/1.3.0.md) for the mode-specific features.
The version is displayed on the home screen.

When reporting a problem, include the Padel Pilot version, watch software
version, scoring configuration and the steps that led to the issue. Do not
attach FIT files publicly if they contain health or location data. Send such
files by email only after agreeing on a safe troubleshooting method.

Padel Pilot is a free-of-charge app and does not provide an emergency or
continuously monitored support service.
